notablePrerequisites:
Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and Dawnsire.
Resolve the Dawnsire trigger, dealing 100 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating 100 Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
